title: Tonopah S4 workers flown in by Janet

tellings.quote: employees on the S4 area of Tonipa test range have to be taken there directly from Janet and cannot drive on site like other employees at Tonipa can.

plain: Workers at S4, a secret site where crashed craft are said to be studied, placed here on the Tonopah Test Range in Nevada, must be flown straight there on Janet, the unmarked airline that carries workers to secret Nevada bases, and cannot drive in like other Tonopah staff, according to a researcher who goes by UAPGerb. UAPGerb puts it this way to Michels: S4 employees "have to be taken there directly from Janet and cannot drive on site like other employees at Tonopah can." If true, it would mark S4 as walled off even from the rest of an already secret base.
